title: Custom LLM Harness: paired Terminal-Bench study
recordType: Curated summary of existing experiment records; not a new benchmark run

method.modelConfiguration: Qwen3.8-27B abliterated checkpoint served through vLLM
method.comparison: Paired difference in average task success

results.interpretation: This experiment did not establish an improvement. Available secondary worker commands were not observed being invoked.

limitations: Selected 30-task subset, one model configuration, three attempts per task and arm.
Infrastructure-invalid attempts were recorded separately and rerun; the 180 scored trials exclude 53 invalid attempts.
Task success is a benchmark outcome, not evidence of general safety or honesty.
The model weights, inference engine, base agent, benchmark environments, and task checkers are upstream components.
Underlying source and run logs remain private; this file is a manually curated results summary.
